description: Build a project glossary from caller-supplied terms: identifier and doc names are normalized and merged, each entry carrying its sources and its supplied definition, if any. Nothing is defined or fetched by the tool.

terms.description: Term occurrences to merge, in the caller's order

definition.description: A definition found in the docs (optional)

name.description: Term as found: an identifier or a doc phrase

source.description: Where the term was found (a path or link), echoed as the entry's source

name: build_glossary
